page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top block of large capitals, the author and title, printed upside down. Centre: the subtitle and the lines of the main title. Below: a framed table of contents, faint and largely show-through. Bottom: place and printer's name, and the year.

main_text.l: Dogmatum, Veritatis, quae secundum pietatem sunt,

page.notes: The upper block and the framed table are faint and partly show-through from the reverse, so their readings are uncertain. The subtitle lines and the table entries could not be read reliably letter by letter. The ornamental rules and the printer's device are not transcribed.
